name: Shinsetsu Match Uri no Shoujo
original_name: 新説・マッチ売りの少女
source:
Once there was a poor street urchin girl who sold matches for a pittance.

"Would you like to buy a matchstick sir?" she said. "Matchsticks, only a penny..."

But nobody paid any mind. So she began to sell her body.

Is there a bright future for the pitiful wretched girl?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ087348.html]English DLsite[/url]]

A bitter, depressing and erotic re-telling of the classic Hans Christian Andersen tale, [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Little_Match_Girl]The Little Match Girl[/url].
translation:
从前，有一个贫穷的流浪女孩，靠低价兜售火柴为生。

“先生，要买根火柴吗？”她问道，“火柴，一分钱一根……”

可没有任何人理会她。于是，她开始出卖身体。

这个悲惨可怜的女孩，未来是否还会出现光明？

[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ087348.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]

这是对安徒生经典童话[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Little_Match_Girl]《卖火柴的小女孩》[/url]的一次苦涩、压抑而色情的重新演绎。
